details: Bitcoin price briefly climbed above $64,000 on Tuesday after the June Consumer Price Index (CPI) in the US fell 0.1% from the prior month, bringing the annual inflation rate to 3.5%—below economists' expectations. This softer inflation data has strengthened the case for potential Federal Reserve interest rate cuts, which can reduce the opportunity cost of holding non-yield-bearing assets like Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Jumps Over $64K as US CPI Falls, Boosting Rate Cut Hopes

details: The US government transferred approximately $297 million worth of seized Bitcoin (3,940 BTC) and Ethereum (30,014 ETH) to Coinbase Prime on July 13. This action, involving assets from various law enforcement cases, has renewed speculation about a potential sale. However, Coinbase Prime offers a range of institutional services including custody, so the transfer does not confirm an immediate liquidation. A sale would also potentially contradict a March 2025 executive order by President Trump to add seized Bitcoin to a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve.
title: US Govt Transfers $297M in Seized BTC & ETH to Coinbase Prime

details: On July 13, the cryptocurrency market experienced a notable capital rotation. Bitcoin slipped 1.58% to $62,789 and Ethereum fell 0.91% to $1,777, in what was described as a selective rather than panic-driven selloff. Concurrently, high-beta altcoins, including DEXE (+15.34%), KITE (+16.88%), and JTO (+10.14%), saw significant gains. This indicates a shift where traders are moving out of larger-cap assets into event-driven smaller altcoins.
title: Crypto Market Rotation: BTC & ETH Slip, High-Beta Altcoins Jump

details: The Bonzo Lend protocol, built on the Hedera network, was exploited for approximately $9.05 million. The incident occurred due to an oracle validation flaw where an attacker manipulated the price of the SAUCE token, enabling under-collateralized borrowing. As a result, withdrawals from the protocol have been disabled, and the terms for recovery remain uncertain.
title: Bonzo Lend on Hedera Suffers $9.05M Oracle Exploit

details: Social media mentions for "Bitcoin" (approximately 130,000) and "Ethereum" (around 40,000) have dropped to their lowest levels in 12 months, returning to figures last observed in 2020. This metric, often used to gauge retail investor attention, suggests a decline in public engagement with these leading cryptocurrencies. Analysts suggest this indicates a shift towards a market driven more by structural fundamentals and institutional involvement rather than viral social media hype.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum Tweet Volume Hits 12-Month Lows
